what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 5-0 to accept the three-year transportation bid, the only one received, from Dee Bus.
The committee put off action on masks on buses and in the nurse's office to its March 16 meeting, seeking input from nurses, the bus company and others.
The business manager said year one of the new transportation contract is within the planned budget, and that field trip, athletic and band transport are estimates mostly paid from revolving accounts.
The committee heard an FY23 budget update, including how Chapter 70 state aid compares with the local budget and whether it covers the Monty Tech assessment.
Members approved a Turkey Hill line-item transfer, an algebra II essentials course, a 2023 Italy and Greece trip, and a PTO logo sticker, all 5-0.

why_it_matters: Bus transportation is a school budget line, and a three-year contract with a single bidder fixes its cost basis for the next three budgets, so the contract's increases will carry into the FY23 budget the town votes on.

Because field trip and athletic transport are estimates paid mostly from revolving accounts, the local budget impact depends on how many bus miles are actually used, which the minutes say are rarely reached.
A gap between state Chapter 70 aid and the school budget, as discussed, is what would fall back on the town's tax levy.
